input.overview: On io-shop, the monthly spend totals shown to shoppers who made purchases this month came out lower than what they had actually bought. A code change to the shop stopped updating each shopper's saved running total for the month whenever a purchase was recorded. The shop's statements and checks still read that saved total, so it fell further behind with every purchase. The problem lasted {duration}. Argus estimates the cost to the shop in takings at {customer_loss}. Nobody was paged, so no one on call was pulled in to respond. Argus found a suspected cause but chose not to act on it, because nothing would show whether the test action had worked within the time Argus waits. Instead, Argus recommends rolling io-shop back. Argus also proposed a fix, PR #554, which is open as a draft and has not been run. Neither step has changed the shop yet.
